title: Welcome to Logic! 🧩
description: Logic is like solving mysteries! You need to think step-by-step and figure out what makes sense. In code, logic helps us solve problems by thinking carefully about each piece.

concepts.name: What is Logic?
concepts.explanation: Logic is about thinking through problems step by step. Each step needs to make sense and lead to the solution!

concepts.name: Variables and Values
concepts.explanation: Variables are like boxes that hold information. We need to be careful when moving things between boxes so we don't lose anything!

examples.title: Losing Data (Bad!)
code: x = y;  // x is now 20, but original 10 is lost!
// We lost the original value of x!

examples.title: Swapping Safely
code: let temp = x;  // Save x in temporary box
x = y;         // x gets y's value
y = temp;      // y gets original x value

concepts.name: Order Matters
concepts.explanation: The order we do things in code is very important. Doing steps in the wrong order can cause problems!

examples.title: Wrong Order
code: console.log(message);  // Error! message doesn't exist yet
// This won't work because we use message before creating it

code: // This works because we create before we use
